page.content:
Fire Lord who began the war on the comet.

How Sozin connects

  • Faction: Fire Nation — Sozin was the Fire Lord who began the war.
  • Event: Sozin's Comet — Sozin used the comet to destroy the Air Nomads.

What is Sozin?

Sozin is Roku's friend-turned-imperial, the Fire Lord whose comet attack on the Air Nomads starts the Hundred Year War.

Key threads lead to Fire Nation and Sozin's Comet.
